response.sql: WITH per_order AS (SELECT ordersmark, AVG(fillcount) AS avg_fill_size FROM orderexecutions GROUP BY ordersmark), first_filtered AS (SELECT ordersmark, avg_fill_size, avg_fill_size - AVG(avg_fill_size) OVER () AS margin_over_all FROM per_order), second_benchmark AS (SELECT AVG(avg_fill_size) AS group_avg FROM first_filtered WHERE margin_over_all > 0), final_orders AS (SELECT f.avg_fill_size, f.margin_over_all, f.avg_fill_size - b.group_avg AS margin_over_group FROM first_filtered f CROSS JOIN second_benchmark b WHERE f.margin_over_all > 0 AND f.avg_fill_size > b.group_avg) SELECT AVG(avg_fill_size) AS avg_per_order_fill_size, AVG(margin_over_all) AS avg_margin_over_all, AVG(margin_over_group) AS avg_margin_over_second FROM final_orders;
